Its executive director left in June 2026 and the Foundation said it will remain without an ED for the foreseeable future, moving technical direction to a Technical Leadership Committee launched 2026-10-13. haskell.org also lists a GHC Steering Committee. The linked roadmap is the GHC release-status wiki cited by the official GHC blog, not a language-wide vision document. GHCup is listed as an official installer on haskell.org; its source repository is on Codeberg.
